purpose: Translate completed independent holdouts and pre-outcome feasibility work into clear system roles without changing the frozen 100-point RK-MIS score.

DISCOVERY_PRIMARY.reason: Strict documentary evidence remains the most direct representation of forward business runway and moat, but the July-2023 historical NSE-only reconstruction produced a mechanical maximum of 21 two-family eligible companies versus the preregistered minimum 30. The holdout therefore stopped before review and before future outcomes. This is an evidence-coverage limitation, not a negative return result.

QUALITY_RISK_FILTER.reason: The 2023 objective-core interaction holdout was modestly positive, but the independent 2020-to-2023 replication failed across mean lift, rank correlation, 2x concentration and loss control. The positive 2023 result therefore does not generalize sufficiently to admit this slice as a primary multibagger discovery signal.

CONFIRMATION_TIMING.reason: The 2022 technical holdout improved 5x concentration and mean multiple in the top quartile but materially worsened loss rate and had negative rank correlation.

SMART_MONEY_CONTEXT.reason: The standalone promoter-accumulation holdout was adverse. In the 2023 objective-core same-cohort extension, adding promoter change increased 2x incidence but reduced mean return, reduced rank correlation and increased top-quartile losses by 7.15 percentage points. At the 2020 anchor no replay-grade 4-quarter promoter series was available, so no additional promoter inference is allowed.

decision_framework.candidate_creation: Prefer chronology-safe runway, moat, catalyst and management-execution evidence when available; use broader authorized sources or prospective live evidence rather than weakening historical review rules.
decision_framework.candidate_ranking: Use recent growth and financial quality only as supporting ranking and risk context, because a positive 2023 interaction result failed independent time-anchor replication.
decision_framework.candidate_rejection: Use governance, weak cash/quality, excessive leverage and evidence gaps as fail-closed or risk-reducing context where applicable.
decision_framework.entry_confirmation: Use technical accumulation only after the business thesis qualifies; do not let technical strength manufacture a thesis.
decision_framework.smart_money_confirmation: Require multiple independent smart-money components rather than promoter holding change alone.
decision_framework.missing_evidence: Never convert missing historical evidence to zero and never lower review rules to increase sample size.
decision_framework.weight_changes: No pillar weight or band may change from one holdout; independent replication and a separate preregistered admission decision are required.

pending_experiments.purpose: Test promoter activity only as one component alongside FII/MF breadth, institutional participation, delivery accumulation and high-quality block/bulk activity.
Track current runway, moat, catalyst and management-execution evidence prospectively under the same strict approval rules, avoiding sparse historical document reconstruction.
Preserve financial-quality usefulness by testing sector-appropriate risk guards rather than assuming a universal industrial ranking signal.
